title: Tempo Three To One Smooth (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 130bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica acoustic
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, tempo is the secret sauce
Three to one back to through, never lost
Smooth is the swing, smooth is the shot

[Verse 1]
Count to yourself one and two on the way back
Then one on the way down, three to one track
Slow back fast through, the tempo formula
Every great swing has the same coda

[Pre-Chorus]
Dont rush the top, son, pause one beat
Let gravity start the down swing seat
Transition is where amateurs lose it
Pros pause, then sequence, never abuse it

[Chorus]
Tempo three to one smooth, son
One and two back, one down done
Slow back fast through, the rhythm of the great
Smooth is the swing, never debate

[Verse 2]
Metronome practice at sixty beats per minute
Back swing two beats, down swing one beat in it
Same tempo on every club, son
Wedge to driver, tempo is one

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, when the pressure rises
Tempo speeds up, surprises arise it
Slow your breathing, slow your routine
Tempo stays smooth, never mean

[Chorus]
Tempo three to one smooth, son
One and two back, one down done
Slow back fast through, the rhythm of the great
Smooth is the swing, never debate

[Outro]
Three to one, smooth flow
Metronome sixty, son, you know
Same tempo every club
Thats my boy, thats the hub
